evals.prompt: Make a flyer for our community health fair using ./brand/brand.json. It's Saturday 14 November, 10am to 2pm, at the Riverside Park pavilion, free. There'll be blood pressure and glucose checks, flu shots with no appointment, a kids' corner and cooking demos. People should register at northwindhealth.example/fair. Letter size.
assertions: Uses the supplied brand.json, so the flyer carries the brand logo and colours
The headline is ten words or fewer and names the event
There is exactly one call to action, worded as a verb, with northwindhealth.example/fair
The date, time, place and price match the prompt exactly; nothing is invented (no phone number, no extra dates)
Runs build_flyer.py and reports the contrast figures and any warnings
Picks the event layout, or explains choosing another, because the date is the key fact
